purpose: Prevent locally correct material changes from leaving the wider project state semantically stale or contradictory.
principle: A material change is not systemically integrated until its impact on the current whole, including the existing planning/execution cursor, has been explicitly reconciled. Unchanged is a valid disposition; silence is not.
promotion_boundary: A material PR may be technically mergeable while reconciliation is incomplete; it must not be described as systemically integrated until the reconciliation gate passes. Reconciliation may expose a next decision or work candidate but does not manufacture priority, scope or implementation authority.
history_rule: The current reconciliation packet may be replaced by later material changes because Git history preserves prior packets; do not create a parallel reconciliation registry by default.
